narrative.overview: TrọCare feels like a dependable daily operations desk: calm, explicit, and familiar to Vietnamese boarding-house owners. Design serves the task and keeps financial, contract, and occupancy state auditable.
keyCharacteristics: Clear Vietnamese labels and action-oriented hierarchy.
Restrained blue accent on neutral, high-contrast surfaces.

rules.name: The One Action Color Rule
rules.body: Operational Blue is the only primary action color in authenticated product surfaces.

rules.name: The State Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Semantic colors are forbidden as decoration and always require a non-color cue.

rules.name: The Vietnamese First Rule
rules.body: Labels must remain readable with Vietnamese diacritics; excessive tracking and routine all-uppercase labels are prohibited.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface uses a border or a shadow at rest, not both as decoration.

dos: Do make the next operational action obvious.
Do preserve entered values after errors.
donts: Don't use generic AI-generated SaaS dashboards.
Don't use decorative glassmorphism or gradient-heavy finance interfaces.
Don't add gratuitous animation or unfamiliar controls.
